text:
Sam: Quick Q — what hand prep are people using for slab vs crimps? my skin keeps shutting me down on projects :grimacing:
Ava: For crimps I do a light file then liquid chalk. For long slabs I actually avoid tape and rely on friction chalk + callus maintenance
Ben: I swear by micro-tape on the last two sessions before a project. saves skin on those tiny edges
Maya: +1 to liquid chalk. Also split sessions: limit attempts so skin recovers. And do a 5-min antagonist band routine after
Jon: anyone tried FingerSox or those little sticky sleeves? they were meh for me
Sam: @Maya any recs for a cheap file or technique?
Maya: I use a cheap pedal file from pharmacy, gentle strokes along the edge. happy to bring it tonight
Ava: if you want a brand rec: FrictionLabs Rescue Balm helps for rei-breaks. link: https://frictionlabs.com/rescue-balm
Ben: Quick tape pattern I use: `wrap at base, cross over nail, finish with single strip` — keeps pad from ripping
Climb-bot: Reminder: Project night tonight 6pm @MainGym — bring tape, both brushes, and lots of water :mountain:
Sam: Nice, thanks! I'll try the micro-tape + balm combo. See you tonight. :thumbsup:
Maya: I'll bring a couple extra tape rolls and a file.
Jon: I can demo a 10-min antagonist set if people want. short, easy, prevents tendon ache.
Ava: Poll: who wants a 10-min skin/care demo before climbing? react with :hand: if yes.
Ben: :hand:
Sam: :hand:
Maya: :hand:
Jon: :hand:
Ava: cool — looks like a majority. See y'all 6pm.
